_comment: The avatar art (Milestone 16, user, 6 Nov 2026): one sheet per age group and sex, made by the team with an AI image tool (CC BY 4.0, README). tools/cut_avatar_sheets.py cuts the originals in assets/art/avatar/source/ into 5 x 5 even cells of the avatar's size; the team upscaled those (source/upscaled/, 7 Nov 2026), and the tool makes one picture per body and face from them, at twice the avatar's size: <folder>/<body>_<face>.png. Bodies and faces are in the order below. mouth_y is the height of the mouth as a share of a cell, from the top (where the meal fork aims). Body: obese, overweight (weight wins over muscular), thin, muscular, otherwise healthy. Face: asleep, tired, sad, happy, otherwise neutral. eat_mouth_y (Milestone 40, documentation/ui_v2/files.md): the mouth in the eating pictures (eat_open_<body>.png and eat_closed_<body>.png, the healthy body), as a share of their height from the top (the meal fork aims there). The activity pictures (running, squats, push-ups, sit-ups, eating; the team's activity sheets, 22 Nov 2026, tools/cut_activity_sheets.py) exist for each body: <folder>/<name>_<body>.png, for example run_left_obese.png; the bed has one picture.
